selection.root: first eligible central-present ROOT CKey; archive availability never selects a later ROOT row
selection.candidates: all ordered encoding alternatives and every nine-byte index-prefix collision, including missing-index alternatives; no content promotion/fallback

limits.total_bytes_scope: conservative sum for all indexed candidates including repeated, unknown-size, unreadable and unsupported candidates
limits.frame_scope: 4096 per candidate BLTE object after complete record read, not aggregate per FDID
limits.memory: charge private plans, fixed3diagnostics, actual candidate capacities and one fallibly allocated record to existing resident/scratch/combined limits; caller serialization separate; logical admission, not RSS/all CPU

read.admission: all plans, candidate counts, conservative total bytes and output reserves before requested payload I/O; held-file metadata open can precede per-record allocation; record extent/capacity checked before payload read
read.linux: existing nofollow regular-file held/named identity before/after exact range seek/read; no anchored ancestor or atomic snapshot guarantee
read.windows: existing readonly fixed NTFS ReadFile/ancestor lease and explicit final verification
read.guards: held/named or Windows final checks after success, parse rejection, allocation/budget/read failure; outer store guards on success and error, observed changes reject whole report

inspection.NotRead: distinct missing/index/archive/unsupported/unsafe/invalid/incomplete span or unknown size; no payload buffer
inspection.Rejected: complete record read; static code with no partial frame evidence
inspection.Complete: only complete supplied BLTE framing evidence; FramedMd5 or explicitly HeaderlessUnhashed
inspection.frame_md5: all declared encoded-frame MD5s, including zero hashes and later frames after E
inspection.Z: outer framing only; no inflate or interior/termination check
inspection.E: outer name-size0/8,nonce-size4/8,cipherS,nonemptyciphertext; no key/nonce/bytes exposed, no decrypt/interior check
inspection.headerless: no frame MD5 or table declaration; not equivalent to framed integrity
inspection.public_evidence: copied form/sizes/optional declared size/NZE counts/frame-MD5 count, safe ordinals and route/span labels; no digest,key,path,offset,nonce,payload
